def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    seeds=[(i,j) for i in range(1,h-1) for j in range(1,w-1)
           if g[i][j]==2 and all(g[i+di][j+dj]==3 for di in(-1,0,1) for dj in(-1,0,1) if (di,dj)!=(0,0))]
    hlines=[r for r in range(h) if all(g[r][c] in (2,3) for c in range(w))]
    vlines=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c] in (2,3) for r in range(h))]
    def ring(i,j):
        for a in range(i-1,i+2):
            for b in range(j-1,j+2):
                if 0<=a<h and 0<=b<w and (a,b)!=(i,j) and g[a][b]!=3:
                    out[a][b]=1
    for (i,j) in seeds:
        horiz = j-2>=0 and j+2<w and g[i][j-2]==2 and g[i][j+2]==2
        if horiz:
            for sign in (1,-1):
                crosses=sorted((r-i)*sign for r in hlines if (r-i)*sign>0)
                start=2
                for c in crosses:
                    for d in range(start,c-1):
                        p=i+sign*d
                        if 0<=p<h: out[p][j]=1
                    ring(i+sign*c,j)
                    start=c+2
                for d in range(start,h):
                    p=i+sign*d
                    if 0<=p<h: out[p][j]=1
        else:
            for sign in (1,-1):
                crosses=sorted((c-j)*sign for c in vlines if (c-j)*sign>0)
                start=2
                for c in crosses:
                    for d in range(start,c-1):
                        p=j+sign*d
                        if 0<=p<w: out[i][p]=1
                    ring(i,j+sign*c)
                    start=c+2
                for d in range(start,w):
                    p=j+sign*d
                    if 0<=p<w: out[i][p]=1
    return out
'''
